calls.video_title: This Pullback is a Gift. I'm Buying These 3 Stocks NOW.
calls.price_at_call: ~$2.3B mkt cap; fwd P/E ~25 (stated); up ~90% YTD
calls.thesis: Small-cap cybersecurity niche: blocks DDoS floods and routes legitimate traffic so sites/apps stay reachable; cheap vs CrowdStrike (~147x fwd earnings) at 1/100th the size, with room to grow 5x and still be a fraction of CRWD.
calls.base_case: Cyberattacks keep coming; specialist players with real fundamentals survive and compound.
calls.bull_case: 5x upside still leaves it far smaller than CrowdStrike; mid-cap cyber names get bought out or re-rate.
calls.bear_case: Not every small cyber name makes it; up ~100% YTD so momentum buyers may be late; not a full-stack player like CRWD/PANW.
